def unique_jobs(rows):
    """Return rows with duplicates removed, keeping the first occurrence.

    Deduplication is based on the (source, source_id) pair; rows with the
    same source are never merged even if titles match. Rows with a missing,
    None or empty source_id are each kept separately.
    The input rows are not mutated.
    """
    result = []
    seen = set()
    for r in rows:
        source = r.get('source')
        source_id = r.get('source_id')
        if not source_id:
            # Missing/None/empty source_id: keep this row separately.
            result.append(r)
            continue
        key = (source, source_id)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        result.append(r)
    return result

from jobs import unique_jobs

rows = [
    {'source': 'a', 'source_id': 'x', 'title': 'same'},
    {'source': 'a', 'source_id': 'x', 'title': 'same'},
    {'source': 'a', 'source_id': 'y', 'title': 'same'},
    {'source': 'b', 'source_id': 'x', 'title': 'same'},
    {'source': 'a', 'title': 'missing id'},
    {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '', 'title': 'empty id'},
    {'title': 'no source', 'source_id': '1'},
    {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'first'},
    {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'dup'},
]
out = unique_jobs(rows)
assert len(out) == 7, out
# first occurrences preserved by order
assert out[0] == {'source': 'a', 'source_id': 'x', 'title': 'same'}
assert out[1] == {'source': 'a', 'source_id': 'y', 'title': 'same'}
assert out[2] == {'source': 'b', 'source_id': 'x', 'title': 'same'}
assert out[3] == {'source': 'a', 'title': 'missing id'}
assert out[4] == {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '', 'title': 'empty id'}
assert out[5] == {'title': 'no source', 'source_id': '1'}
assert out[6] == {'source': 'a', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'first'}
# input not mutated
assert rows[0]['title'] == 'same'
assert len(rows) == 9

# empty and None source handling
assert unique_jobs([]) == []

dup_rows = [{'source': 's', 'source_id': None, 'title': 't'},
            {'source': 's', 'source_id': '', 'title': 't'}]
